title: Chinese Stew with Cannellini Beans
description: A hearty and flavorful Chinese-inspired stew made with cannellini beans, aromatic spices, and tender beef. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the aromatic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the beans and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, until the beans are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped scallions if desired.
